title: rubus moluccanus var. hasskarlii
intro: Rubus moluccanus var. hasskarlii, commonly known as Moluccan raspberry, is a plant species in the family Rosaceae. It is a type of plant used in traditional medicine, particularly in Southeast Asian countries, for its potential health benefits. The plant has been reported to possess various therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may contribute to its health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Rubus moluccanus var. hasskarlii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
